description.en: Yohoia-inspired static teaching arthropod with a subrectangular head shield, paired elbowed anterior appendages and four long terminal fingers, segmented trunk and paddle telson. Fine anatomy and counts simplified; no flagellate whip fingers or lanceolate tail.
description.zh: Yohoia启发静态教学节肢动物，具方形头甲、成对肘状前附肢及四根末端长指、分节体和桨状尾。细节与数量简化；无鞭丝指或矛头尾。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
